buildings.name: Excavation Site
buildings.effect: Digs a ruin site layer by layer; each layer turns up research, resources or danger (a defence system, a pathogen).
buildings.description: A dig over the ruins of a dead species: trenches, scaffolding, a gantry crane and sifting screens. Only it can stand on a ruin hex. Its crew dig one layer at a time, and every layer turns something up: artifacts and data cores for research, a fragment of their technology, a cache of metal, dilithium or latinum, or trouble. A woken defence system damages everything nearby and locks the dig for a while (Artifact Analysis finds more of them disarmed); a released pathogen makes the base's crew sick and slow (Xenomedicine shortens it). Needs crew and a little power, and wears like any machine. Once the last layer is dug, salvage it.
